messages.label: scam
messages.text: USPS: Shipment [number] is on hold at our facility due to insufficient postage ($1.25). Pay the balance to schedule delivery, otherwise it will be returned in 48hrs [link]
messages.note: Unrequested USPS text with link and small fee

messages.label: scam
messages.text: SunPass Notice: You have an outstanding toll balance of $4.15. Failure to pay by 11/18 may result in penalties and DMV registration suspension. Pay online: [link]
messages.note: Fake toll text threatening registration suspension, with payment link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Internal Revenue Service - Taxpayer Advocate. Due to a recent processing error, an adjusted refund of $932.17 has been issued in your name. Please complete the attached form with your direct deposit information so we can release the payment.
messages.note: IRS doesn't email asking for bank details; fake refund

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hi, this is Kevin with Chase fraud prevention, I'm following up on the text you just replied NO to. Someone's trying to send Zelle payments from your checking. To reverse them, I'm going to have you send the same amount to yourself on Zelle using a secure ID I'll give you, and that cancels it out.
messages.note: Fake fraud department walking victim through a Zelle transfer to the scammer

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Grandpa? It's me... I'm so sorry, I got pulled over and they found something in my friend's car, I'm at the station now. Please don't call Dad, he'll kill me. There's a public defender here who can explain the bail, can you talk to him?
messages.note: Grandparent scam: arrest, secrecy, hand-off to a fake lawyer

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello, this is Megan from a staffing agency. Your resume was found on our partner site. We have a flexible remote position, 1-2 hrs/day, pay $180-$350/day. Are you interested? Please reply 1 for yes
messages.note: Unsolicited remote job text with high pay and reply prompt

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hey sweetheart, just got off a 14 hr shift at the base. Sorry I couldn't call again, the connection out here is terrible. I was looking at flights home for Thanksgiving, I really want to meet you in person finally. I'll tell you more tomorrow, there's something I need to ask you but I'm nervous.
messages.note: HARD: deployed 'soldier' who can't call, building up to an ask; no money or link yet

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Thank you for calling Microsoft Windows Support, my name is Jason. I see the alert on your screen, ma'am, your system has been compromised with a Trojan. Please don't turn off the computer. I'm going to need you to download a support tool so I can remove it, and then we'll discuss the protection plan.
messages.note: Fake support line reached via pop-up, asks for remote access and payment

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: This is Agent Mike, badge [number], with the Department of Homeland Security. Your Social Security number was used to rent a vehicle found with narcotics at the border. You are a suspect at this time. Do not hang up and do not speak to your bank, I'll explain how to secure your assets while we clear your name.
messages.note: Fake federal agent threatening arrest, secrecy, 'secure your assets'

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Harris County Court Notice: You did not report for jury selection on 11/10. A failure-to-appear citation is pending. Call the clerk's office at [number] today to resolve this before it is forwarded to the sheriff.
messages.note: Fake court notice threatening a warrant over missed jury duty

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hi, this is the billing department at the electric company. We show two missed payments on your account and a crew is scheduled to disconnect you this afternoon. I can stop it if you make a payment now, we accept Zelle or Apple Pay.
messages.note: HARD: matter-of-fact call demanding same-day payment by app to stop shut-off

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi, I saw your ad for the dog walking. We're moving to Denver next month and my husband's company will mail you a check for the first month. They tend to send extra for our moving expenses, so if it's more I'd just ask you to forward the rest to our mover. Hope that's ok!
messages.note: HARD: friendly client setting up a check overpayment and forward-the-difference

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Bank of America: Your one-time code is [number]. We'll never call you to ask for this code. Don't share it with anyone.
messages.note: Genuine one-time code with do-not-share warning

messages.label: safe
messages.text: USPS: Your item [number] was delivered in or at the mailbox at 2:14 pm in AUSTIN, TX. Reply STOP to cancel text updates.
messages.note: Tracking text the user signed up for, no link or payment

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey Mom, can you Venmo me $60 for my half of the electric bill? Josh already paid his share. Thanks for the soup btw, I'm feeling way better. Call you Sunday
messages.note: Child from usual number with personal context; normal small request

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your Social Security cost-of-living adjustment notice for next year is available. To view it, sign in to your my Social Security account yourself at the SSA website. SSA will never ask for your Social Security number or bank details by email.
messages.note: Government notice telling you to sign in yourself, no link

messages.label: safe
messages.text: This article about how to spot fake toll texts made me think of your dad lol [link]
messages.note: Friend sharing an article link, no request

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reminder: Open enrollment for 2027 health benefits closes this Friday at 11:59 pm. If you don't make a selection, you'll be enrolled in the default plan. Log in to the HR portal as usual to review your options. - People Team
messages.note: Work deadline email, urgent but directs to the usual internal portal

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Thanks for your order! Target order [number]: 1 x Keurig coffee maker, 2 x K-cup variety packs. Total $112.47. Estimated delivery Wed, Nov 19. We'll send tracking once it ships.
messages.note: Shop order confirmation for a real purchase

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reminder: Your appointment with Dr. Karen at the family medicine clinic is Mon 11/24 at 9:40 AM. Please bring your Medicare card and arrive 10 min early. Reply C to confirm.
messages.note: Normal doctor appointment reminder

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey it's Marcus, got a new phone through work so this is my new number. Lmk if you're still down for the game Sunday
messages.note: Friend announcing a new number, asking for nothing

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi! Is the stroller still available? Does it fold flat enough to fit in a sedan trunk? I could pick it up tomorrow evening and pay cash.
messages.note: Normal marketplace buyer question, cash pickup

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hi! You recently received a free sample package from our store. Scan the QR code on the packing slip or tap here to leave a quick review and claim a $25 Amazon gift card: [link]
messages.note: Unordered package follow-up luring you to a link or QR

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hi Linda, it's Kevin from the exchange support desk. Your bank put a hold on the last wire, so to keep your position open we'll switch to a cash deposit. Withdraw $18,000 and our courier will meet you at your door at 2pm. He'll show you a dollar bill with serial ending in [number]. Please don't discuss it with the bank teller.
messages.note: Fake crypto platform sending a cash courier to collect

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Urgent from the campaign: we're $40K short of our end-of-month goal and the other side is outspending us 3 to 1. Chip in $25 now and your donation will be MATCHED 5x: [link]
messages.note: Fake PAC donation text with matching pressure and link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Your NFL playoff hospitality package is on hold for 30 minutes. Only 4 premium suites remain at the stadium. Complete your booking with card or wire on the official partner site to secure your seats: [link]
messages.note: Fake ticket/hospitality site pushing quick payment

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello, I am an agent with the FBI Internet Crime Complaint Center. Your recent complaint about the investment platform has been reviewed and a portion of your funds has been located. Please reply with your full name, date of birth and bank details so we can initiate the release.
messages.note: Fake IC3 agent offering to return lost money

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hi, I'm calling from a local care program for seniors. We're offering free in-home help with cleaning and groceries, paid by Medicare. You qualify, all I need is your Medicare number and date of birth to get you signed up with our partner today.
messages.note: HARD: Hospice enrollment fraud disguised as free home help

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hi, is this Robert? This is Mark with the national sweepstakes office. You've won our second-prize award of $350,000 and a new SUV. Before the delivery team comes out, federal law requires a $650 tax pre-payment. Can you go to the store today and pick up gift cards for that?
messages.note: Fake prize call demanding a fee via gift cards

messages.label: scam
messages.text: hey whats up, saw u in the comments on that gaming stream lol. ur funny. u got insta? we should talk there 😊
messages.note: HARD: first friendly contact of a sextortion setup aimed at a teen

messages.label: scam
messages.text: USPS: Hi, we've noticed the delivery address on your package doesn't match our records. Please confirm your address within 12 hours so we can reschedule: [link]
messages.note: Fake USPS address-fix text with link

messages.label: scam
messages.text: FasTrak: Your account shows an unpaid toll of $7.40 from 11/12. To avoid a $35 late fee and registration hold, pay by today: [link]
messages.note: Fake toll text threatening late fees

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Wells Fargo Fraud Alert: Did you attempt a Zelle transfer of $1,250.00 to Mike T.? Reply YES or NO.
messages.note: HARD: short fraud alert text with no link, first step to a fake fraud call

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Hello, Mrs. Johnson? My name is Daniel Miller, I'm an attorney representing your grandson Tyler. He was in a car accident this morning and the other driver is pressing charges. He's okay but he's very embarrassed and asked me not to tell his parents. Bail has been set and I can help you take care of it quietly today.
messages.note: HARD: fake lawyer calling about grandchild, secrecy and bail

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Hello, I'm Jessica, HR at a digital marketing company. We received your resume from an online job board. We have a part-time remote position with $200-500 daily pay, no experience required. Can I tell you more?
messages.note: HARD: Unsolicited remote job offer with vague high pay

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Caller: Good afternoon, this is Officer Brian Taylor with the Social Security Administration's Office of Inspector General. We've suspended your Social Security number due to suspicious activity in Texas. To avoid arrest, you need to verify your identity and secure your funds today. Please stay on the line and don't tell anyone.
messages.note: Fake government officer threatening arrest and secrecy

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Social Security Administration: Your benefit statement has been updated. Due to a payment discrepancy, your benefits may be paused. Download the attached statement and confirm your bank details within 72 hours to avoid interruption.
messages.note: Fake SSA email with attachment and bank details request

messages.label: scam
messages.text: Duke Energy: Your account is 2 payments behind. Service disconnection is scheduled for today at 4 PM. To avoid shutoff, pay now by Zelle or call [number].
messages.note: Fake utility shut-off text demanding payment via app

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Chase: We declined a transaction of $412.00 at an electronics website because it looked unusual. If you don't recognize it, please call the number on the back of your card. We'll never ask for your PIN or password.
messages.note: Real fraud alert directing you to the number on the card

messages.label: safe
messages.text: FedEx: Your package was left with the front desk at your building on 11/15 at 3:40 PM. No signature needed. Track in the FedEx app with tracking [number].
messages.note: Real delivery confirmation, no payment

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey Mom, can you Venmo me $40 for the textbook? It's the same one the professor said we need for finals. Thanks, love you. Talk Sunday!
messages.note: Child from usual number with context and small known request

messages.label: safe
messages.text: 🎁 GIVEAWAY! To celebrate our 3rd anniversary, we're giving away a free dozen donuts every week in November! Just follow us and comment your favorite flavor. Winners announced here every Friday. No purchase or personal info needed. - Sweet Spot Bakery
messages.note: Real shop giveaway on its own page, nothing asked

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Team, the client moved the demo to 8 AM tomorrow. I need your slides in the shared drive by 6 PM tonight. Sorry for the short notice, pizza's on me tomorrow. Thanks, Ryan
messages.note: Urgent work request from manager, internal drive

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your Amazon verification code is [number]. Don't share it with anyone. Amazon will never call to ask for it.
messages.note: Real 2FA code with do-not-share warning

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi Emily, just confirming what we discussed: rent stays at $1,450 for the next year, due on the 1st as always through the same tenant portal. Let me know if you have any questions. Thanks, Robert
messages.note: Landlord confirming agreed rent via usual portal

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hey it's Ashley! Switched carriers so this is my new number. Nothing needed, just save it. Let's get coffee soon!
messages.note: Friend's new number, asks nothing

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Hi! Is the bike still available? What size is the frame? I could swing by Saturday morning to check it out and pay cash if it fits.
messages.note: Normal marketplace buyer questions, cash in person

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Reminder from the IRS: your estimated tax payment for the fourth quarter is due January 15. To make a payment or view your balance, sign in to your IRS Online Account yourself. The IRS will never email you asking for personal or financial information.
messages.note: Government reminder telling you to sign in yourself

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Lincoln Elementary: Due to a power outage, school will dismiss at 12:30 PM today. Please pick up your child or arrange for an approved adult. Students will be supervised until 3 PM.
messages.note: Urgent school notice, nothing requested

messages.label: safe
messages.text: Your E-ZPass statement for October is ready. Your balance is $0.00 and auto-replenishment is on. No action is needed. To review your account, sign in through the E-ZPass app or website you normally use.
messages.note: Real toll statement with zero balance and no link
